<h2><a id="user-content-dependencies" class="anchor" href="#dependencies" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Dependencies</h2>

<p>This document depends on the following packages:</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre>library(<span class="pl-smi">devtools</span>)</pre></div>

<p>To install these packages you can use the code (or if you are compiling the document, remove the <code>eval=FALSE</code> from the chunk.)</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r,"><pre>install.packages(<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>devtools<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)</pre></div>

<h2><a id="user-content-make-the-code-pretty" class="anchor" href="#make-the-code-pretty" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Make the code pretty</h2>

<p>Set the color scheme and pch.</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-c">## Color scheme inspired by the RSkittleBrewer package</span>
<span class="pl-c">## https://github.com/alyssafrazee/RSkittleBrewer</span>
<span class="pl-v">tropical</span><span class="pl-k">=</span>  c(<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>darkorange<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>, <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>dodgerblue<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>, <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>hotpink<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>, <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>limegreen<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>, <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>yellow<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>)
palette(<span class="pl-smi">tropical</span>)
par(<span class="pl-v">pch</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">19</span>)</pre></div>

<p>Unfortunately for R markdown documents the <code>pch</code> won't propagate unless you do something a little more messy. We'll hide this later, but for now this is what you need to do to set the default. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-c">## see ch. 10 Hooks of Xie's knitr book</span>
library(<span class="pl-smi">knitr</span>)
<span class="pl-smi">knit_hooks</span><span class="pl-k">$</span>set(<span class="pl-v">setPch</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-k">function</span>(<span class="pl-smi">before</span>, <span class="pl-smi">options</span>, <span class="pl-smi">envir</span>) {
  <span class="pl-k">if</span>(<span class="pl-smi">before</span>) par(<span class="pl-v">pch</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">19</span>)
})
<span class="pl-smi">opts_chunk</span><span class="pl-k">$</span>set(<span class="pl-v">setPch</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">TRUE</span>)</pre></div>

<p>We will again hide this in future documents, but this shows how to set a default figure width and height, as well as setting plot margians. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-e">knitr</span><span class="pl-k">::</span><span class="pl-smi">opts_chunk</span><span class="pl-k">$</span>set(<span class="pl-v">fig.width</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span>, <span class="pl-v">fig.height</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span>, <span class="pl-v">size</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>footnotesize<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
                      <span class="pl-v">warning</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">FALSE</span>, <span class="pl-v">message</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">FALSE</span>)
<span class="pl-e">knitr</span><span class="pl-k">::</span><span class="pl-smi">knit_hooks</span><span class="pl-k">$</span>set(<span class="pl-v">small.mar</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-k">function</span>(<span class="pl-smi">before</span>, <span class="pl-smi">options</span>, <span class="pl-smi">envir</span>) {
  <span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-smi">before</span>) <span class="pl-e">graphics</span><span class="pl-k">::</span>par(<span class="pl-v">mar</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> c(<span class="pl-c1">5</span>,<span class="pl-c1">5</span>,<span class="pl-c1">1.5</span>,<span class="pl-c1">1</span>))
})</pre></div>

<h2><a id="user-content-compiling-documents" class="anchor" href="#compiling-documents" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Compiling documents</h2>

<ol>
<li>Try compiling this document using the "Knit HTML" button. What files are produced?</li>
<li>Edit the output to be "pdf_document" and recompile. What files are produced?</li>
<li>Edit the output to be "word_document" and recompile. What files are produced?</li>
</ol>

<h2><a id="user-content-naming-code-chunks" class="anchor" href="#naming-code-chunks" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Naming code chunks</h2>

<p>The label "chunk1" tells you which part of the code was running in case you have errors. If you compile this document you'll see it under the "R markdown" window on R studio. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-v">x</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> rnorm(<span class="pl-c1">100</span>)
plot(<span class="pl-smi">x</span>,<span class="pl-v">col</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">3</span>)</pre></div>

<h2><a id="user-content-headers" class="anchor" href="#headers" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Headers</h2>

<h1><a id="user-content-this-is-a-primary-header" class="anchor" href="#this-is-a-primary-header" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>This is a primary header.</h1>

<h2><a id="user-content-this-a-secondary-header" class="anchor" href="#this-a-secondary-header" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>This a secondary header</h2>

<h3><a id="user-content-this-is-a-tertiary-header" class="anchor" href="#this-is-a-tertiary-header" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>This is a tertiary header</h3>

<h2><a id="user-content-lists" class="anchor" href="#lists" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Lists</h2>

<p>You can create bulleted and numbered lists in the following way. </p>

<ul>
<li>Bullet item 1</li>
<li>Bullet item 2</li>
<li><p>Bullet item 3</p></li>
</ul>

<ol>
<li>Numbered item 1</li>
<li>Numbered item 2</li>
<li>Numbered item 3</li>
</ol>

<h2><a id="user-content-figures" class="anchor" href="#figures" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Figures</h2>

<p>The main arguments you might want to change are centering and figure height. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-v">x</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> rnorm(<span class="pl-c1">100</span>)
plot(<span class="pl-smi">x</span>,<span class="pl-v">col</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">3</span>,<span class="pl-v">pch</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">19</span>)</pre></div>

<h2><a id="user-content-other-chunk-arguments" class="anchor" href="#other-chunk-arguments" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Other chunk arguments</h2>

<p>Add a chunk option of <code>echo=FALSE</code> to hide the code. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre><span class="pl-v">x</span> <span class="pl-k">=</span> rnorm(<span class="pl-c1">100</span>)
plot(<span class="pl-smi">x</span>,<span class="pl-v">col</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">3</span>,<span class="pl-v">pch</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">19</span>)</pre></div>

<p>Setting <code>cache=TRUE</code> makes it so that the code won't take as long to compile the second time. To see this, uncomment the code below and then run the document twice. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre>Sys.sleep(<span class="pl-c1">10</span>)</pre></div>

<h2><a id="user-content-session-information" class="anchor" href="#session-information" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>Session information</h2>

<p>It is very useful to record the session information when performing analyses so you can collaborate with yourself in the future. </p>

<div class="highlight highlight-r"><pre>sessionInfo()
<span class="pl-e">devtools</span><span class="pl-k">::</span>session_info()</pre></div>

<p>It is also useful to compile the time the document was processed. This document was processed on: <code>r Sys.Date()</code>.</p>
</article>
